source_change_scope: Only tools/native_runner.js in candidate package; review artifacts are separate.

launch_ledger.other_statuses: 0 active; every other value or getter exception uncertain

shutdown_query_limits.runtime_note: WMI/COM enumeration and status calls have no hard deadline imposed by this JScript wrapper.

exact_row_rules.successful_empty_enumeration: retire only that original snapshot row
exact_row_rules.readable_same_identity: full original guard evaluates refreshed command
exact_row_rules.persistent_unreadable: retry same row identities within bounds; preserve lock on exhaustion

verification.runtime_mocks: Separate regression_review agent owns tests; no result asserted here.

limitations: A process inventory is a time-dependent observation, not an atomic operating-system process snapshot.
The sealed ledger closes this runner's native launch routes and verifies returned process statuses; it is not a Windows Job Object or a general descendant-containment mechanism.
Live unreadable processes are never declared unrelated or ignored by parent identity.
The old retained v0.2.16 lock is not removed by this package; a new versioned workspace is used.
